## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what a user or contributor can do after this change.
Link a related issue if one exists.

## Affected scope

For Blender behavior, identify affected objects/data, permissions, ownership/dependency
checks, user context, file effects and recovery behavior. For documentation-only changes,
describe the corrected claim or entry point.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. For native changes, include the exact
Blender/OS/source and runner evidence. State unavailable or untested environments.
For docs, include relevant link and generated-inventory checks.

## Remaining limitations

Describe partial behavior, compatibility changes or follow-up work. Keep published release
behavior separate from unreleased development; passing smoke tests does not qualify 1.0.
